title: SearchReplaceApplyResult
description: `POST /search/replace`: the report of applying a replace across the files named by the request (plan 11, B-11, D-05) — per file, one of four outcomes.

applied.description: Relative to the folder, with /. Written, with the trail entry ahead of the disk write (S-83).

changed.description: The disk no longer held the version the preview read — preserved, never overwritten (S-84, S-98).

missing.description: Gone since the preview — never recreated (S-86).

skipped.description: Turned binary or grew past the edit ceiling since the preview (S-87), or needs the confirmation a sensitive file needs for any write.
